<div class="review-text">
Absolutely fantastic. It's Subnautica, but more. Tons of the minor design issues I had with the first game (which are minor) are resolved in Below Zero, taking all of the parts that made it good and just turning it perfect. There's plenty to build, explore, and engage with. Highly recommend, especially to people who enjoyed the first game.
